points.en: SEZ is a designated duty-free enclave treated as foreign territory for trade operations.
points.hi: SEZ is a designated duty-free enclave treated as foreign territory for trade operations.

points.en: Governed by the SEZ Act, 2005 to promote exports and attract FDI.
points.hi: Governed by the SEZ Act, 2005 to promote exports and attract FDI.

points.en: Single window clearance mechanism for setting up units.
points.hi: Single window clearance mechanism for setting up units.

points.en: Exemption from customs duties on imports and domestic procurement.
points.hi: Exemption from customs duties on imports and domestic procurement.

points.en: Income tax benefits under Section 10AA of the Income Tax Act.
points.hi: Income tax benefits under Section 10AA of the Income Tax Act.

points.en: No license required for import; full freedom for subcontracting.
points.hi: No license required for import; full freedom for subcontracting.

explanation.en: Foreign territory status, Export promotion, Duty-free imports, Single-window clearance.
explanation.hi: Foreign territory status, Export promotion, Duty-free imports, Single-window clearance.

question.en: What is the primary objective of the SEZ Act, 2005?
question.hi: What is the primary objective of the SEZ Act, 2005?

answer.en: To create an internationally competitive and hassle-free environment for exports.
answer.hi: To create an internationally competitive and hassle-free environment for exports.

misconception.en: SEZs are part of the Domestic Tariff Area (DTA).
misconception.hi: SEZs are part of the Domestic Tariff Area (DTA).

correction.en: SEZs are considered foreign territory for trade, duties, and tariffs, unlike the DTA.
correction.hi: SEZs are considered foreign territory for trade, duties, and tariffs, unlike the DTA.

fiveFacts.en: SEZ Act came into effect in 2006.
fiveFacts.hi: SEZ Act came into effect in 2006.

fiveFacts.en: Board of Approval is the apex body for SEZ clearance.
fiveFacts.hi: Board of Approval is the apex body for SEZ clearance.

fiveFacts.en: SEZs can be set up by private, public, or state governments.
fiveFacts.hi: SEZs can be set up by private, public, or state governments.

fiveFacts.en: Units must be net foreign exchange positive.
fiveFacts.hi: Units must be net foreign exchange positive.

fiveFacts.en: SEZs provide infrastructure support for manufacturing and services.
fiveFacts.hi: SEZs provide infrastructure support for manufacturing and services.

threeTraps.en: Assuming SEZs are exempt from all labor laws.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming SEZs are exempt from all labor laws.

threeTraps.en: Confusing SEZ with Export Oriented Units (EOU).
threeTraps.hi: Confusing SEZ with Export Oriented Units (EOU).

threeTraps.en: Thinking SEZs are only for manufacturing; they also include services.
threeTraps.hi: Thinking SEZs are only for manufacturing; they also include services.
